20261005-ice-ice-september-adv-up.headline: ICE September ADV up 51% with record financials open interest
20261005-ice-ice-september-adv-up.summary: Total ADV rose 51% YoY in September 2026 and 31% in Q3, and open interest was up 13%. Energy ADV grew 26%. Total financial futures OI hit a record 17.5m lots and Euribor OI a record 6m lots on 10 September.

20261029-ice-ice-expects-marketaxess-dea.headline: ICE expects MarketAxess deal to close in Q1 2027 after HSR clearance
20261029-ice-ice-expects-marketaxess-dea.summary: US antitrust authorities granted early termination of the HSR waiting period for ICE's acquisition of MarketAxess on 21 October 2026. ICE now expects to close in Q1 2027, earlier than the first-half 2027 timeline it gave in July. Other approvals are still pending.

20261103-nse-india-nse-board-clears-sale.headline: NSE board clears sale of up to 40% of National Coal Exchange unit
20261103-nse-india-nse-board-clears-sale.summary: Alongside its Q2 FY27 results, the NSE board approved divesting up to a 40% stake in its subsidiary National Coal Exchange of India. SEBI had earlier cleared NSE to invest in the proposed coal exchange.

20261027-tadawul-saudi-exchange-adds-rul.headline: Saudi Exchange adds rules blocking internal matching, requiring gross order routing
20261027-tadawul-saudi-exchange-adds-rul.summary: The CMA board approved amendments on 12 October to Saudi Exchange rules that stop internal matching of orders and require orders to reach the market on a gross basis, with the aim of making order flow more transparent. The changes take effect on 13 December 2026.

20261103-cme-cme-group-posts-record.headline: CME Group posts record October ADV of 30 million contracts, up 15%
20261103-cme-cme-group-posts-record.summary: October 2026 ADV hit a record 30.0m contracts, up 15% YoY. Interest rate ADV rose 28% to 14.8m and equity index ADV rose 15% to 8.8m. US Treasury futures and options grew 48% to 9.2m, and BrokerTec US repo set a record ADNV of $419.5bn.

20261028-bse-october-options-premium-tur.headline: October options premium turnover jumps 43%; BSE daily contracts overtake NSE
20261028-bse-october-options-premium-tur.summary: Combined average daily options premium turnover at NSE and BSE rose about 43% MoM in October 2026, and daily contracts rose 39%. BSE's premium turnover rose 61% to a record, against 34% at NSE. BSE's average daily contracts passed NSE's.

20261020-bmv-grupo-bmv-q3-revenue.headline: Grupo BMV Q3 revenue up 5%, net income MXN 397m
20261020-bmv-grupo-bmv-q3-revenue.summary: Q3 2026 revenue rose 5% YoY to MXN 1,161m and EBITDA rose 2% to MXN 635m. The EBITDA margin fell 180bp to 55% because operating expenses grew 12% under the Digital Evolution programme. Net income was flat at MXN 397m (+1%). Cash equities ADTV was MXN 17.1bn (+1%), and MexDer revenue rose 19%.

20261007-deutsche-boerse-eurex-september.headline: Eurex September volumes up 45% to 273 million contracts
20261007-deutsche-boerse-eurex-september.summary: Eurex traded 273.0m contracts in September 2026, up 45% YoY, led by interest rate derivatives (+61% to 168.2m). OTC clearing notional outstanding rose 29% to EUR 60.1tn, and Eurex Repo term-adjusted volume grew 33% to EUR 615bn.

20261104-ice-october-adv-up-14.headline: ICE October ADV up 14%, with record Brent options and TTF open interest
20261104-ice-october-adv-up-14.summary: ICE's average daily volume rose 14% YoY in October 2026 and open interest grew 10%. Financials ADV rose 39% (interest rates +40%), agriculture and metals rose 39%, and TTF gas ADV rose 40%. Brent options and TTF gas open interest set records of 5.3m and 5.9m lots on 26 October.

20261011-spb-spb-exchange-plans-crypto.headline: SPB Exchange plans crypto trading by end-2026 via own digital depository
20261011-spb-spb-exchange-plans-crypto.summary: SPB Exchange aims to launch cryptocurrency trading before the end of 2026 and is building its own settlement digital depository, which must register with the Bank of Russia. MOEX, by contrast, will use partners' infrastructure. The list of tradable assets has not been set.

20261030-b3-b3-changes-trading-hours.headline: B3 changes trading hours as US and European daylight saving ends
20261030-b3-b3-changes-trading-hours.summary: B3 changed its session schedule from 3 November 2026: the regular equity session now closes at 17:55, followed by a closing call to 18:00, and there is no equity after-market except on option expiry days. European-linked contracts switched hours on 26 October.

20261106-hkex-hkex-q3-profit-dips-1.headline: HKEX Q3 profit slips 1% as cash turnover cools
20261106-hkex-hkex-q3-profit-dips-1.summary: Q3 2026 profit attributable to shareholders fell 1% to HKD 4.86bn, while revenue and other income rose 1% to HKD 7.87bn. Headline ADT fell 11% to HKD 254.2bn and the EBITDA margin dropped 2 points to 79%. For the first nine months, profit rose 15% to HKD 15.43bn, and 118 IPOs raised HKD 388.4bn.

20261105-euronext-euronext-launches-350m.headline: Euronext launches EUR 350m share buyback
20261105-euronext-euronext-launches-350m.summary: Euronext will buy back up to EUR 350m of its own shares, about 2% of share capital, from 9 November 2026 for up to twelve months. Net debt was 1.1x EBITDA at end-September, inside the range set by its Innovate for Growth 2027 plan.

20261029-tmx-tmx-q3-revenue-up.headline: TMX Q3 revenue up 17% to C$491m; adjusted EPS up 21%
20261029-tmx-tmx-q3-revenue-up.summary: Q3 2026 revenue rose 17% to C$491.1m, or 11% excluding the recent Cboe Australia and RAFI Indices acquisitions. Net income fell 12% to C$105.8m because of FX hedge losses and deal costs, while adjusted diluted EPS rose 21% to C$0.63. TMX issued C$1.1bn of new debentures to fund the acquisitions.

20261015-msci-msci-proposes-moving-indon.headline: MSCI proposes moving Indonesia from Emerging to Standalone market status
20261015-msci-msci-proposes-moving-indon.summary: MSCI opened a consultation on reclassifying its Indonesia indexes as Standalone, pointing to concerns over opaque shareholdings, suspected coordinated trading and reforms whose enforcement is still unproven. Feedback is open until 30 April 2027, with a decision due by 30 June 2027. MSCI expects to go ahead unless it sees clear evidence of material improvement, and the freeze on certain Indonesian index changes stays in place.

20261102-kase-kase-global-foreign-securi.headline: KASE Global foreign-securities segment trades KZT 32.1bn in October
20261102-kase-kase-global-foreign-securi.summary: KASE Global, the segment for foreign stocks and ETFs, traded KZT 32.13bn (about USD 71.3m) in October 2026, against KZT 34.6bn in September. Shares made up KZT 23.3bn and ETFs KZT 8.8bn. Individuals accounted for 28% of the volume.

20261007-asx-asx-september-activity-futu.headline: ASX September activity: futures volumes up 44%, cash trading up 4%
20261007-asx-asx-september-activity-futu.summary: Average daily futures contracts rose 44% YoY in September to about 1.43m. On-market cash value averaged A$7.74bn a day, up 4%. Total new capital quoted fell 84% to A$4.2bn against a high September 2025 base. For Q1 FY27 (Jul–Sep), on-market ADV rose 9% to A$7.42bn, futures volumes rose 33%, and there were 29 new listings.

20261021-cme-cme-group-q3-revenue.headline: CME Group Q3 revenue up 13% to record $1.74bn
20261021-cme-cme-group-q3-revenue.summary: Q3 2026 revenue rose 13% to $1.74bn and adjusted EPS rose 13% to $3.02, ahead of consensus. Quarterly ADV was a record 29.4m contracts, up 16%. CME guided to full-year adjusted opex of about $1.695bn.

20261030-cboe-cboe-q3-net-revenue.headline: Cboe Q3 net revenue up 18% to $712m; growth target raised
20261030-cboe-cboe-q3-net-revenue.summary: Q3 2026 net revenue rose 18% to $712.2m and net income to common rose 43% to $426.7m. That included a $71.5m gain on the sale of Cboe Australia. Adjusted EPS grew 36% to $3.63. Cboe raised its organic net revenue growth target to high teens, cut its adjusted opex guidance to $830-845m and added $550m to its buyback authorization.

20261102-moex-moscow-exchange-9m-2026.headline: Moscow Exchange 9M 2026 standalone RAS profit falls 27% on lower dividends
20261102-moex-moscow-exchange-9m-2026.summary: On a standalone RAS basis, MOEX's 9M 2026 net profit fell 26.8% YoY to RUB 61.6bn, mainly because dividends from subsidiaries dropped 29% to RUB 55.9bn. Fee and service income rose 16.9% to RUB 25.4bn. Q3 standalone profit was RUB 2.2bn (-5.5%). IFRS group results for Q3 are still to come.

20261007-kase-kase-amends-rules-enable.headline: KASE amends rules to enable carbon-unit-backed instrument trading
20261007-kase-kase-amends-rules-enable.summary: Rule changes approved by the KASE board took effect on 6 October 2026. They allow primary and secondary trading in clearing participation certificates whose collateral pool consists of carbon units. Seven internal documents were amended, including the trading rules and the fee schedule.

20261102-moex-moscow-exchange-october-20.headline: Moscow Exchange October 2026 trading volume RUB 212.9trn, down from September
20261102-moex-moscow-exchange-october-20.summary: Total MOEX trading volume in October 2026 was RUB 212.9trn, against RUB 220.8trn in September. Money market was RUB 169trn, derivatives RUB 16.7trn (down from RUB 20.6trn), equities and funds RUB 2.8trn (ADTV RUB 125bn), and secondary bonds RUB 2.4trn. The release gives no YoY comparison.

20261022-lseg-lseg-q3-income-up.headline: LSEG Q3 income up 8.8%; raises full-year guidance
20261022-lseg-lseg-q3-income-up.summary: Q3 2026 total income excluding recoveries grew 8.8% at constant currency. Markets grew 12.5%, FTSE Russell 10.2%, Risk Intelligence 9.8% and Data & Analytics 5.2%. LSEG now expects revenue growth of at least 8% and 100-120bp of EBITDA margin expansion, and it highlighted the planned purchase of Octus and of Trumid's credit trading services.

20261102-nasdaq-nordic-october-turnover-.headline: Nasdaq Nordic October share turnover up 18%
20261102-nasdaq-nordic-october-turnover-.summary: Average daily share turnover on Nasdaq Nordic and Baltic markets rose 18.4% YoY to EUR 3.71bn in October 2026. Cleared derivatives fell 3.5% to 237,426 contracts a day, and order-book share in listed stocks was 75.1%.

20261027-sp-global-sp-global-reviewing-o.headline: S&P Global reviewing options, including separation, for Capital IQ data business
20261027-sp-global-sp-global-reviewing-o.summary: S&P Global said it is exploring strategic alternatives, including a possible separation, for Capital IQ and related data businesses, which sit mostly within Market Intelligence's Kensho Data & Platforms. It plans to keep RatingsDirect, RatingsXpress and Enterprise Solutions. No timeline was set, and no transaction is assured.

20261102-euronext-euronext-picks-nn-grou.headline: Euronext picks NN Group's David Knibbe to succeed CEO Stéphane Boujnah
20261102-euronext-euronext-picks-nn-grou.summary: Euronext plans to nominate NN Group CEO David Knibbe as its next CEO and Chairman of the Managing Board. Boujnah, in the job since 2015, steps down in May 2027, and Knibbe's nomination goes to the 20 May AGM. The choice surprised some observers, who had expected CFO Giorgio Modica to get the role.

20261030-cboe-cboe-extends-exclusive-sp.headline: Cboe extends exclusive S&P index options license through 2051
20261030-cboe-cboe-extends-exclusive-sp.summary: With its Q3 results, Cboe said its exclusive license with S&P for index options such as SPX now runs to 2051. Index options are Cboe's main growth engine, and index options ADV rose 24% in Q3.

20261028-bursa-malaysia-bursa-malaysia-q.headline: Bursa Malaysia Q3 net profit up 10% to RM70.2m on stronger trading
20261028-bursa-malaysia-bursa-malaysia-q.summary: Bursa Malaysia's Q3 2026 revenue rose 20.3% YoY to RM216.4m, and net profit rose 10% to RM70.2m. For the nine months, net profit was up 13.5% at RM214.8m, securities ADV was up 27% at RM3.4bn, and derivatives daily contracts were up 19.3% at 113,120. The 47 IPOs year to date raised RM6.1bn, and management says it remains on track for its FY2026 targets.

20261025-sse-sse-adds-15-single.headline: SSE adds 15% single-stock cap to Shanghai Composite, STAR indices
20261025-sse-sse-adds-15-single.summary: The Shanghai Stock Exchange and China Securities Index Co. revised the methodology for the Shanghai Composite, SSE A-Share, SSE Free Float and STAR Composite indices. Any single constituent is now capped at 15% weight, and risk-warning stocks are removed sooner. The changes took effect on 26 October 2026.

20261029-dfm-dfm-nine-month-pre.headline: DFM nine-month pre-tax profit falls 37% despite 22% traded value rise
20261029-dfm-dfm-nine-month-pre.summary: DFM's 9M 2026 pre-tax profit was AED 586.4m, down from AED 930.8m, which had included AED 461.9m from a one-off property sale. 9M revenue was AED 753.2m. Q3 revenue fell to AED 196.2m from AED 204.5m, and Q3 pre-tax profit to AED 143.2m. Traded value rose 22% to AED 162bn, and 55,460 new investors joined.

20261103-nse-india-nse-q2-fy27-profit.headline: NSE Q2 FY27 profit up 23% to INR 2,578 crore in first post-listing results
20261103-nse-india-nse-q2-fy27-profit.summary: NSE's consolidated net profit for Jul–Sep 2026 rose 23% YoY to INR 2,578 crore, and total income grew about 9% to INR 4,554 crore. Transaction charges rose 9% to INR 3,035 crore. Operating EBITDA roughly doubled to INR 3,079 crore (76% margin), helped by the base effect of last year's INR 1,297 crore SEBI settlement provision. Cash-market ADTV rose 24% to INR 1.18 lakh crore. These are the first results since the September 2026 listing.

20261028-morningstar-morningstar-launche.headline: Morningstar launches Direct AI
20261028-morningstar-morningstar-launche.summary: Morningstar said in its Q3 release that it launched Direct AI in October 2026. Higher cloud and AI-related technology spending was one of the main drivers of operating expense growth in the quarter.

20261020-msci-msci-q3-revenue-rises.headline: MSCI Q3 revenue rises 12.4% to $892m; adjusted EPS $5.11
20261020-msci-msci-q3-revenue-rises.summary: MSCI's Q3 2026 operating revenues grew 12.4% to $892.0m. Net income rose 7.9% to $351.0m, and adjusted EPS rose 14.3% to $5.11. Run rate reached $3.57bn (+12.1%), retention was 95.0%, and buybacks in the quarter and through 19 October totalled $627m.

20261103-mcx-mcx-q2-fy27-profit.headline: MCX Q2 FY27 profit up 130% to INR 455 crore as revenue doubles
20261103-mcx-mcx-q2-fy27-profit.summary: MCX revenue from operations rose 114% YoY to INR 799.7 crore in Jul–Sep 2026, and consolidated net profit rose about 130% to INR 454.6 crore. EBITDA was INR 611.2 crore, a 76.4% margin against 65.1% a year earlier. Average daily options turnover was about INR 12 lakh crore and futures INR 62,819 crore.

20261102-krx-korea-exchange-unveils-road.headline: Korea Exchange unveils roadmap to move stock settlement to T+1
20261102-krx-korea-exchange-unveils-road.summary: KRX plans to shorten equity settlement from T+2, a cycle in place since 1972, to T+1. Supporting systems are targeted for completion by October 2027, followed by about six months of testing, so the switch could happen in 2028. KRX will first consult authorities, domestic and foreign firms, and overseas investors.

20261104-bse-bse-q2-fy27-profit-up.headline: BSE Q2 FY27 profit up 45% to INR 809 crore, beating estimates
20261104-bse-bse-q2-fy27-profit-up.summary: BSE's revenue from operations for July–September 2026 rose 34% YoY to INR 1,432.7 crore and net profit grew 45% to INR 809 crore, ahead of consensus of about INR 755 crore. EBITDA rose 42% to INR 984 crore, a margin of about 69%. Both lines fell 7–9% QoQ as transaction charges dipped after SEBI's new closing auction session started in August.

20261103-gpw-gpw-october-equity-turnover.headline: GPW October equity turnover up 35.6% YoY to PLN 59.5bn
20261103-gpw-gpw-october-equity-turnover.summary: Main-market share turnover reached PLN 59.5bn in October 2026 (+35.6% YoY), with average daily turnover of PLN 2.62bn (+39.7%). The WIG and WIG20 both closed at record highs on 29 October. NewConnect turnover fell 31.9%.

20261103-deutsche-boerse-eurex-clearing-.headline: Eurex Clearing plans hybrid CCP for native digital instruments
20261103-deutsche-boerse-eurex-clearing-.summary: Eurex Clearing will clear native digital instruments, starting with ESM digital issuance in Eurex Repo GC Pooling, under its existing rulebook and risk model, calling itself the first hybrid CCP. The service links to Clearstream's Digital Infrastructure with Eurosystem Pontes central bank money settlement, and the assets will be eligible as margin collateral.

20261005-gpw-gpw-goes-live-new.headline: GPW goes live with new WATS trading system across all markets
20261005-gpw-gpw-goes-live-new.summary: GPW moved all its markets onto the in-house GPW WATS trading platform on 5 October 2026, and trading opened on schedule. Main-market turnover that day was about PLN 1.9bn. GPW later confirmed that all first-day trades settled correctly.

20261027-jpx-jpx-cancel-49m-treasury.headline: JPX to cancel 9.49m treasury shares on November 10
20261027-jpx-jpx-cancel-49m-treasury.summary: JPX will cancel 9,486,700 treasury shares, about 0.92% of issued shares, on 10 November 2026. Issued shares will then total 1,022,298,636.

20261102-bse-sensex-options-hit-record.headline: Sensex options hit record INR 35,481 crore average daily premium in October
20261102-bse-sensex-options-hit-record.summary: Average daily premium turnover in BSE Sensex options rose 53% to a record INR 35,481 crore in October 2026. NSE's average daily premium was INR 63,227 crore, its highest since March 2026. Volatility linked to West Asia tensions and oil above USD 100 drove the activity.

20261027-jpx-jpx-h1-profit-jumps.headline: JPX H1 profit jumps 66% as cash equity trading nearly doubles
20261027-jpx-jpx-h1-profit-jumps.summary: For April–September 2026, JPX operating revenue rose 46.7% to JPY131.0bn, operating income rose 65.1% to JPY84.7bn, and net income rose 65.6% to JPY57.2bn. Daily cash equity trading value averaged JPY11.9tn, up 89.5%. Clearing revenue rose 79.5%, helped by income on IRS collateral. The full-year forecast, already raised on 24 September to JPY252.5bn revenue and JPY105bn net income, was kept unchanged, along with an annual dividend of JPY82.

20261022-deutsche-boerse-deutsche-borse-.headline: Deutsche Börse Q3 net revenue up 13%; 2026 outlook raised again
20261022-deutsche-boerse-deutsche-borse-.summary: Q3 2026 net revenue rose 13% to EUR 1,633m, or 14% to EUR 1,415m excluding treasury income. EBITDA grew 16% to EUR 978m and net profit grew 18% to EUR 559m. Guidance was raised for the second time, to net revenue above EUR 6.5bn and EBITDA of about EUR 3.9bn. Clearstream's Securities Services net revenue rose 10% to EUR 288m.

20261104-cboe-october-index-options-reco.headline: Cboe index options set monthly ADV record of 6.9m contracts in October
20261104-cboe-october-index-options-reco.summary: Cboe's proprietary index options averaged 6.89m contracts a day in October 2026, up 25% YoY and a monthly record, with SPX at a record 5.5m and SPX 0DTE at a record 3.6m. Multi-listed options ADV fell 10.3% to 14.3m and US on-exchange equity volume fell 24% to 1.53bn shares. European equities notional rose 1.9% to EUR 13.4bn.

20261028-dtcc-tokenization-service-goes-.headline: DTCC tokenization service goes live; Morgan Stanley among first users
20261028-dtcc-tokenization-service-goes-.summary: DTC launched the DTCC Tokenization Service on 28 October 2026, letting holders convert DTC-held securities into tokens sent to their own wallets on Canton or DTCC's private Besu network, with more chains planned for 2027. Twenty participants signed up at launch, and SEC no-action relief covers Russell 1000 stocks, index ETFs and Treasuries. On 4 November Morgan Stanley said it had tokenized US equities and Treasuries through the service.

20261006-hkex-hong-kong-ipo-proceeds.headline: Hong Kong IPO proceeds top HK$388bn in nine months; pipeline above 600
20261006-hkex-hong-kong-ipo-proceeds.summary: KPMG's Q3 review counts 116 Hong Kong listings in the first three quarters of 2026, raising more than HK$388bn. That is over twice the prior-year figure and the highest nine-month total on record. Hong Kong ranks second globally behind Nasdaq. More than 600 applications are active, and KPMG sees full-year proceeds near HK$500bn, which would beat the 2010 record of HK$449.5bn.

20261102-lseg-dsd-gate-2-approval.headline: LSEG digital depository wins sandbox Gate 2 approval for digital gilt pilot
20261102-lseg-dsd-gate-2-approval.summary: LSEG's Digital Securities Depository received Gate 2 approval in the UK Digital Securities Sandbox to perform notary, maintenance and settlement functions. It also gained approval for a settlement link with HSBC Orion, so it can serve as an investor depository for the DIGIT digital gilt, subject to settlement-finality designations. LSEG's Digital Settlement House is set to handle the cash leg for delivery-versus-payment.

20261022-nasdaq-nasdaq-q3-net-revenue.headline: Nasdaq Q3 net revenue up 13% to $1.48bn; ARR reaches $3.4bn
20261022-nasdaq-nasdaq-q3-net-revenue.summary: Q3 2026 net revenue rose 13% (14% organic) to $1,481m, and GAAP net income rose to $540m from $423m. Non-GAAP EPS grew 18% to $1.04. Index revenue jumped 39% on record ETP AUM of $1.16tn, ARR rose 12% to $3.37bn, and 2026 non-GAAP opex guidance moved to $2.55-2.58bn.

20261021-moodys-moodys-q3-revenue-up.headline: Moody's Q3 revenue up 1% to $2.02bn; guidance reaffirmed
20261021-moodys-moodys-q3-revenue-up.summary: Moody's Q3 2026 revenue rose 1% to $2,023m (3% organic constant currency). MIS fell 1% against a record prior-year quarter, while MA grew 3%. Adjusted diluted EPS rose 6% to $4.14, which the press read as a miss. Full-year guidance (adjusted EPS $16.50-17.00) was left unchanged.

20261028-morningstar-morningstar-q3-reve.headline: Morningstar Q3 revenue up 8.9%; adjusted EPS jumps 36.5%
20261028-morningstar-morningstar-q3-reve.summary: Q3 2026 revenue rose 8.9% to $672.1m (6.8% organic). Operating income rose 31% to $167.4m, and adjusted diluted EPS rose 36.5% to $3.48. Morningstar Credit and Retirement led growth, while Morningstar Wealth revenue fell 4.3%.

20261031-cdsl-cdsl-q2-fy27-profit.headline: CDSL Q2 FY27 profit rises 24% to INR 173 crore on IPO boom
20261031-cdsl-cdsl-q2-fy27-profit.summary: CDSL's consolidated net profit rose 24% YoY to INR 173 crore, and total income rose 22% to INR 417 crore. Profit was up 47% on the June quarter. About 7.5 million demat accounts were added in the quarter, taking the total above 19.34 crore. Assets under custody passed INR 89 lakh crore.

20261103-dtcc-dtcc-wins-esma-arm-licence.headline: DTCC wins ESMA approval as MiFID reporting mechanism
20261103-dtcc-dtcc-wins-esma-arm-licence.summary: ESMA authorised DTCC to run an Approved Reporting Mechanism for MiFID transaction reporting. The platform was scheduled to go live in early November 2026 and to replace fragmented legacy reporting channels.

20261026-tadawul-saudi-tadawul-group-q3.headline: Saudi Tadawul Group Q3 net profit falls 42% on weaker trading
20261026-tadawul-saudi-tadawul-group-q3.summary: Q3 2026 operating revenue fell 8.1% YoY to SAR 292.2m, and net income to shareholders fell 41.8% to SAR 48.1m as trading values weakened. Nine-month net income was down 34.6% at SAR 195.8m. Technology and data services was the only growing segment (+5.8% over nine months).

20261015-nse-india-sebi-drops-closing-au.headline: SEBI drops closing-auction F&O settlement and restores VWAP method
20261015-nse-india-sebi-drops-closing-au.summary: In a 15 October circular, SEBI reversed its plan to settle expiring derivatives off the closing auction session. It restored settlement on the VWAP of the last 30 minutes, for index constituents and for stocks across exchanges. A 3:30–3:40pm closing auction in cash still starts on 7 December 2026. On expiry days, expiring index contracts stop trading at 3:30pm. The order-carryover rules take effect on 8 February 2027.

20261007-jpx-jpx-publishes-topix-revamp.headline: JPX publishes TOPIX revamp review results; TOPIX Next-tier index starts Oct 30
20261007-jpx-jpx-publishes-topix-revamp.summary: JPX Market Innovation & Research released the results of its periodic review and initial constituent selection under the new TOPIX methodology. The overhaul focuses on liquidity, and Bloomberg reports it will drop hundreds of stocks from the index. Calculation of a new TOPIX Next-tier index begins 30 October 2026, and stocks under transitional measures will be re-evaluated in October 2027.

20261103-borsa-istanbul-borsa-istanbul-c.headline: Borsa Istanbul chief Korkmaz Enes Ergun arrested in fund probe; acting CEO named
20261103-borsa-istanbul-borsa-istanbul-c.summary: Korkmaz Enes Ergun, general manager since 2021, was detained on 31 October on suspicion of bribery and criminal-organisation membership. A court ordered him held in pretrial detention on 3 November. Deputy CEO Atila Tureli was named acting chief executive on 1 November, and warrants were also issued for former CMB officials.

20261029-ice-ice-reports-record-q3.headline: ICE reports record Q3 with net revenues up 15% to $2.8bn
20261029-ice-ice-reports-record-q3.summary: Q3 2026 net revenues rose 15% to $2.8bn. Adjusted diluted EPS rose 18% to $2.02 and GAAP EPS rose 18% to $1.67, while adjusted operating income grew 19% to $1.7bn. CEO Jeff Sprecher called it ICE's best third quarter ever, and ICE had returned $2.5bn to shareholders year to date.

20261022-nasdaq-nasdaq-sets-23-trading.headline: Nasdaq sets 23/5 trading for December, forms Digital Liquidity Networks
20261022-nasdaq-nasdaq-sets-23-trading.summary: Alongside its Q3 results, Nasdaq said The Nasdaq Stock Market plans to launch 23-hours-a-day, five-days-a-week trading on 6 December 2026. It also set up a Nasdaq Digital Liquidity Networks unit within Market Services and closed its acquisition of LeveL Markets early in Q4.

20261105-euronext-euronext-q3-revenue-up.headline: Euronext Q3 revenue up 25% to record; opex guidance cut
20261105-euronext-euronext-q3-revenue-up.summary: Q3 2026 revenue and income rose 24.9% to EUR 547.4m (+17.6% like-for-like), with FICC Markets up 48% and Equity Markets up 33%. Adjusted EBITDA rose 31.6% to EUR 364.2m, a 66.5% margin, and reported net income rose 30.2% to EUR 194.9m. Euronext lowered its 2026 underlying opex guidance to EUR 760m from EUR 770m.

20261027-sp-global-sp-global-q3-revenue.headline: S&P Global Q3 revenue up 7%, raises 2026 revenue and adjusted EPS guidance
20261027-sp-global-sp-global-q3-revenue.summary: Q3 2026 revenue from continuing operations rose 7% to $3.678bn, and adjusted diluted EPS rose 9% to $4.58. Full-year revenue growth guidance was raised to 7.4-8.4%, and adjusted EPS guidance to $17.70-17.95. GAAP EPS guidance was trimmed because expected disposition gains are lower.

20261023-hkex-hkex-launches-proprietary-.headline: HKEX launches proprietary AI and semiconductor indices; mainland ETF licence signed
20261023-hkex-hkex-launches-proprietary-.summary: HKEX launched two proprietary indices. The HKEX Artificial Intelligence Index covers 40 Hong Kong-listed AI value-chain names, and the HKEX Semiconductor Index covers the 30 largest chip-related stocks. HKEX also licensed China Southern Asset Management to issue ETFs on the mainland that track the AI index.

20261105-euroclear-bank-of-russia-seeks-.headline: Bank of Russia asks Brussels court to seize Euroclear documents
20261105-euroclear-bank-of-russia-seeks-.summary: L'Echo reported that the Bank of Russia asked a Brussels court to order Euroclear to hand over records of its contacts with EU institutions in summer 2026. The regulator alleges the July 2026 EU sanctions changes, which block enforcement of Russian rulings, were designed to shield Euroclear. About EUR 200bn is claimed in the main Russian case against Euroclear Bank.

20261027-hkex-hkexs-lme-launches-steel.headline: HKEX's LME launches Steel HRC Shanghai futures linked to SHFE benchmark
20261027-hkex-hkexs-lme-launches-steel.summary: The London Metal Exchange, owned by HKEX, launched a cash-settled, USD-priced Steel HRC Shanghai futures contract. The contract is linked to the Shanghai Futures Exchange's hot-rolled coil benchmark, with 10-tonne lots and monthly expiries out to 12 months. It cleared 2,513 lots on its first day.

20261022-asx-asx-agm-q1-activity.headline: ASX AGM: Q1 activity up, cost guidance reaffirmed, CFO succession announced
20261022-asx-asx-agm-q1-activity.summary: At its AGM, ASX said Q1 FY27 cash market value traded rose 7% YoY and futures volume rose 32%. It reaffirmed FY27 guidance of 18–21% total expense growth and A$180–200m in capex. ASX is acting on the recommendations from ASIC's Inquiry, including building an extra A$150m of capital by June 2027, and is running an ASIC/RBA-approved reset of its Accelerate program. Keir Barnes will succeed retiring CFO Andrew Tobin under new CEO Anthony Attia, and a new strategy is due at a Capital Markets Day in 1H CY2027.

20261030-spb-spb-exchange-9m-2026.headline: SPB Exchange 9M 2026 RAS net loss doubles to RUB 786m
20261030-spb-spb-exchange-9m-2026.summary: SPB Exchange reported a standalone RAS net loss of RUB 786m for 9M 2026, against a RUB 385m loss a year earlier. Interest income fell 56.6% YoY to RUB 115m.

20261102-nse-india-sebi-recommends-scrap.headline: SEBI recommends scrapping LTCG tax on foreign investors' equity gains
20261102-nse-india-sebi-recommends-scrap.summary: Reuters reported that SEBI has proposed removing the 12.5% long-term capital gains tax on foreign investors' equity holdings, ahead of the FY28 Union Budget. SEBI also proposed exempting mutual fund scheme switches held over a year. FPIs have withdrawn about INR 2.87 lakh crore in 2026, and the government has not decided.

20261008-moex-moscow-exchange-targets-de.headline: Moscow Exchange targets 1 December launch of bitcoin, ether and USDT trading
20261008-moex-moscow-exchange-targets-de.summary: MOEX plans to start crypto trading on 1 December 2026 and has begun tests with professional participants. Settlement will run through a partner digital depository. Russia's crypto law took effect on 1 September 2026, and non-qualified investors are limited to RUB 300k a year in BTC, ETH and USDT.

20261103-broadridge-broadridge-q1-fy27-r.headline: Broadridge Q1 FY27 revenue up 5%, recurring revenue up 11%
20261103-broadridge-broadridge-q1-fy27-r.summary: In the quarter to 30 September 2026, total revenues rose 5% to $1,669m and recurring revenues rose 11% to $1,083m (9 points organic). GAAP net earnings fell 43% to $95m, while adjusted EPS rose 3% to $1.56. FY27 guidance was reaffirmed, including 6-8% recurring revenue growth and 8-12% adjusted EPS growth.

20261012-aix-aix-9m-2026-turnover.headline: AIX 9M 2026 turnover tops USD 1.9bn, up 70%; September a record
20261012-aix-aix-9m-2026-turnover.summary: Astana International Exchange trading turnover passed USD 1.9bn in 9M 2026, up more than 70% YoY. September's USD 560m+ was its highest month on record. The exchange added 126 instruments from 77 issuers, and USD 6bn was raised on it during the period. Retail accounts exceed 2.4 million.

20261012-sgx-sgx-september-securities-tu.headline: SGX September: securities turnover up 27%; GIFT Nifty open interest hits record
20261012-sgx-sgx-september-securities-tu.summary: SGX's September securities daily average value rose 27% YoY to S$1.9bn. Derivatives volume slipped 2% to 29.8m contracts, or about 1.4m a day. GIFT Nifty futures and options open interest reached a record US$18.2bn notional, and STI ETFs took record monthly net inflows of S$293m. For the September quarter (Q1 FY27), SDAV was about S$2.0bn, up 33% YoY.

20261005-cboe-cboe-september-index-optio.headline: Cboe September index options ADV up 22%; SPX 0DTE hits record
20261005-cboe-cboe-september-index-optio.summary: Index options ADV rose 22.3% to 6.42m contracts in September 2026, and SPX 0DTE ADV reached a record 3.4m. Multi-listed options ADV edged up 0.7% to 15.4m, while on-exchange US equities volume fell 14.7%.

20261102-borsa-istanbul-fund-scandal-wip.headline: Fund scandal wipes about $128bn off Borsa Istanbul market value
20261102-borsa-istanbul-fund-scandal-wip.summary: Total market cap fell from TRY 20tn on 15 September to TRY 13.6tn on 30 October after investment funds failed to meet redemptions and the CMB ordered 131 funds liquidated. The BIST 100 fell 9.9% in October and posted a record seven straight weekly losses.

20261031-nsdl-nsdl-q2-fy27-revenue.headline: NSDL Q2 FY27 revenue up 36%, net profit up 11% to INR 122 crore
20261031-nsdl-nsdl-q2-fy27-revenue.summary: NSDL's consolidated revenue from operations rose 36.5% YoY to INR 545.9 crore, but net profit rose only 10.9% to INR 122.5 crore, which points to margin pressure. Demat accounts reached about 4.72 crore after 15.6 lakh net additions. NSDL held an 85.8% share of demat custody value.

20261008-cme-cme-international-adv-rises.headline: CME international ADV rises 22% to 9 million contracts in Q3
20261008-cme-cme-international-adv-rises.summary: Contracts traded from outside the US averaged 9m a day in Q3 2026, up 22% YoY. In September alone, international ADV was 9.7m, with EMEA at 7.0m and APAC at 2.3m.

20261106-deutsche-boerse-eurex-october-v.headline: Eurex October derivatives volume up 27%, rates up 42%
20261106-deutsche-boerse-eurex-october-v.summary: Eurex derivatives volumes rose about 27% year on year in October, led by interest rate products up 42%. Eurex Repo term-adjusted volume rose 14% to EUR 534.4bn on GC Pooling, and OTC clearing notional outstanding rose 31% to EUR 64.6tn.

20261109-ice-nyse-avalanche-tokenised-le.headline: NYSE picks Avalanche ledger for clearing on planned tokenised-stock venue
20261109-ice-nyse-avalanche-tokenised-le.summary: Ava Labs said the clearing firm behind ICE's planned NYSE-affiliated tokenised securities ATS will run on Avalanche as its core ledger, after about a year of testing. The venue targets 24/7 trading, clearing and settlement and is meant to support tokenised equities issued on several blockchains; no launch date has been set and regulatory approval is still pending.

20261108-nasdaq-kosakewitsch-europe-head.headline: Nasdaq names Nikolaj Kosakewitsch head of European Market Services
20261108-nasdaq-kosakewitsch-europe-head.summary: Nasdaq appointed Nikolaj Kosakewitsch, previously President of Nasdaq Copenhagen, to lead European Market Services with immediate effect, covering trading, listings, clearing and infrastructure across the Nordic and Baltic exchanges. Predecessor Roland Chai, in the role since January 2024, moves to run Nasdaq's new Digital Liquidity Networks unit for tokenisation and digital-asset liquidity.

20170810-moodys-bureau-van-dijk.summary: Moody's closed its purchase of private-company data provider Bureau van Dijk from EQT, announced in May 2017, folding it into Moody's Analytics.
20170810-moodys-bureau-van-dijk.title: Moody's completes roughly EUR 3bn acquisition of Bureau van Dijk

20170306-borsa-istanbul-derivatives-bist.summary: Borsa İstanbul's derivatives market (VİOP) moved onto the BISTECH platform; the migration programme covering debt and precious metals markets was completed in 2018.
20170306-borsa-istanbul-derivatives-bist.title: Futures and options market migrates to BISTECH

20251127-jpx-arrowhead-cloud-poc.summary: With Fujitsu, TSE began testing whether AWS cloud could host arrowhead's critical functions, including trading, in the long term.
20251127-jpx-arrowhead-cloud-poc.title: TSE starts AWS cloud proof of concept for arrowhead trading functions

b3.summary: B3 runs Brazil's whole exchange stack itself: the PUMA trading system, built with CME and used for equities, derivatives and FX; one multi-asset clearinghouse with the CORE risk model; and its own CSD. All three are being modernised at once: a Nasdaq-based clearing platform, a cloud-native Vermiculus CSD and a 10-year cloud programme with Microsoft and Oracle. Two serious outages in 2025–26 have drawn attention to how resilient that stack is.
b3.tech_business: The Technologies and Platforms segment earned BRL 1.9bn in 2025 (+14.8%). Of that, BRL 1.2bn came from technology: Balcão systems clients, colocation and connectivity. Data and analytics (Trillia) earned a further BRL 1.1bn.

trading.notes: PUMA replaced GTS, Mega Bolsa, BOVESPA FIX and SISBEX. It went live in spot FX on 29 Aug 2011. Derivatives followed later in 2011, and Bovespa-segment equities moved from Mega Bolsa around April 2013. B3 says PUMA has sub-millisecond standard deviation, but it publishes no microsecond latency figure. In Q1 2021, colocated flow made up 39% of cash-equity ADTV and 59% of derivatives volume.

trading.vendor: Co-developed by BM&FBOVESPA and CME Group

clearing.notes: NSCC collects Required Fund Deposits daily on start-of-day portfolios; a 2026 rule filing (SR-NSCC-2026-008) refines the gap-risk charge for ETFs and fat-tail calibration, targeted for 30 October 2026. NSCC's clearing fund fell about 29% (to USD 9.1bn) after the T+1 switch. FICC is expanding sponsored, agency and done-away clearing for the SEC Treasury clearing mandate (cash and repo deadlines pushed back a year, to end-2026 and mid-2027); FICC average daily volume topped USD 10.4tn in Feb 2025. A transformation roadmap through 2028 adds ISO 20022-only client interfaces over MQ/sFTP, partial settlement and longer UTC hours.

settlement.cycle: Euroclear Bank runs an overnight processing cycle plus real-time daytime settlement
settlement.notes: Euroclear Bank is a Model 1 DvP system. It settles DvP in 46 currencies (or FoP) in commercial bank money, increasingly using central bank accounts on CSD links. The Bridge interoperable link to Clearstream Banking Luxembourg is secured by a bank-consortium letter of credit. The ESES CSDs (France, Belgium, Netherlands) moved to T2S in wave 3 on 11 Sep 2016, migrating about 344k balances. Euroclear Finland's Infinity 2 (built with TCS BaNCS) went live on 7 May 2018 and replaced HEXClear and other legacy systems. In June 2026 Euroclear Sweden announced a phased move to a single cloud-based TCS BaNCS platform shared with Finland, with Sweden joining T2S in 2030. EUI is running a multi-year programme to move CREST onto a modular platform. Technology services come from parent Euroclear SA/NV under a shared services agreement.
settlement.platform: Euroclear Bank's Euroclear System (ICSD); ESES for Euroclear France/Belgium/Nederland (settling on T2S); CREST for Euroclear UK & International; Infinity (TCS BaNCS) for Euroclear Finland

trading.notes: The 2009 system (live 4 December 2009) handled about 80,000 orders/s at peak with 30%+ lower average latency than its predecessor. The core trading system moved to x86 for the first time in December 2021 and reached national security protection level 4 in December 2022. A June 2021 plan targeted a new-generation trading system with market readiness by end-2023, but no full equity cutover has been confirmed. A full-network test on 29 September 2024 pushed 270 million orders through the auction system, about twice the historic peak. A self-developed fourth-generation options trading system launched 1 December 2025 with 2.5x order capacity, 7x sustained throughput and 20x lower average processing latency (no absolute figure published). Industry plans target domestic (xinchuang) technology by 2027.

clearing.notes: The Unified Collateral Pool was tested in June 2017 and planned to go live in August 2017. QCCP status came from the Bank of Russia on 18 Oct 2013. Dynamic margin, which recalculates client risk-based margin every 3 minutes, was in place on the derivatives market in 2025. CCP clearing of OTC trades in unlisted shares started in April 2023, alongside the Standardised OTC Derivatives market. Shares and bonds moved to T+1 in 2023. The US sanctions of June 2024 forced NCC to apply its rules to the restriction effects. In 2025 NCC finished import substitution of its front-office transaction-recording system. A Hadoop data lake for reporting was built in 2019.
clearing.platform: Integrated MOEX trading-clearing systems for the equity, FX and derivatives markets, with a Unified Collateral Pool and single limit
clearing.risk_model: Portfolio margining. Collateral is treated as one pool and checked against a Unified Limit. Initial margin, variation margin and stress-scenario models are validated by PwC. Concentration limits are set per risk factor, and Bachelier option pricing was added in 2020 for negative prices.

trading.notes: Bats technology was rolled out to legacy CBOE markets after the 2017 merger: CFE on 2018-02-25, C2 on 2018-05-14 and C1 (Cboe Options) on 2019-10-07. The Titanium brand was announced on 2025-01-15 for US, UK/European, Japanese and Australian markets. Cboe Canada's NEO books moved on 2025-03-03 (MATCHNow in Feb 2022). Cboe says Dedicated Cores cut latency for subscribers by 60% in the US, and BOE ran on average 68.3% faster than FIX through the 90th percentile in Canada. Portfolio changes: Cboe Europe Derivatives (CEDX) was decommissioned in Feb 2026, Japanese equities are being wound down, and Cboe Australia was sold to TMX (July 2026), with Cboe Canada's sale pending.

outages.description: On the first day of the new CDP, trading opened at 10:45 instead of 09:00. Brokers connected over FIX reported missing order confirmations, and some, such as Dhan, halted fresh orders. Crude oil and natural gas were disrupted again in the evening of 17 Oct.

bmv.summary: Grupo BMV trades cash equities on MoNeT, an in-house matching engine live since 2012, and settles through Indeval's DALI system. Since 2024 it has been moving post-trade technology to Nasdaq platforms and building a cloud-based derivatives platform expected in 2027.
bmv.tech_business: Bursatec is BMV's technology subsidiary that built MoNeT; no current sales of BMV technology to other exchanges were found.

trading.colocation: IPC-managed Beeks low-latency hosting at BMV primary and DR sites, announced February 2025 (go-live targeted H2 2025)

latency.metric: order processing time, stated as under 90 microseconds per order (vs ~35-90 ms on the legacy system)

trading.matching_location: Primary data centre in Mexico City, with a disaster-recovery site also in Mexico City
trading.notes: MoNeT is an in-memory Java engine designed for up to 100,000 orders per second (vs ~1,000 before), built for about USD 11.5m; staged rollout began 3 September 2012. MexDer has had an order-routing link with CME Globex since 2011. A new cloud-based derivatives platform covering trading, clearing and collateral is expected in 2027.
